notes.subject: medimo
notes.rationale: אלהים fano ke medimo ya ditšhaba — e ngwalwa ka ditlhaka tše nnye go ya ka molao wa D1; e sego Elohim.

notes.subject: dikete tše masomenne
notes.rationale: Palo e nopotšwe — dikete tše masomenne (40 000) go Yisraele.

notes.subject: יבחר אלהים
notes.rationale: Kganano: 'ba kgetha medimo e mpsha' (setšhaba) kgathanong le 'Elohim o kgetha' — seo se sa dumelelana ka gobane Elohim ga a kgethe medimo.

notes.subject: ⟨ke⟩
notes.rationale: Seheberu se se na le sekopanyi; Sepedi se se nyaka go potšišo go hlaka.

translation: Ba kgetha medimo e mpsha — ka mohla woo go ile gwa ba ntoa makhgorong. A khupu goba hlahlamollo e ka <ke> bonwa gare ga dikete tše masomenne go Yisraele?
